clauses.anchor: Problem, report [#EX-184]: "The Forbidden Fruit's earned damage disappears if the item is removed or rerolled."

Only the removal path is exercised; a reroll is not.

clauses.anchor: Task, sentence 2: "Preserve behaviour outside the reported paths."
clauses.note: The six preserved cases only cover behaviour directly adjacent to six of the repaired reports. Nothing observes any other item, trinket, enemy or character of the mod.

clauses.anchor: Notes, bullet 2: "This is an Afterbirth+ Lua mod, not a Repentance mod. Use APIs available in that runtime."
clauses.note: No case checks API usage. A Repentance-only call shows up only indirectly, as a failure of whatever behaviour it breaks in the pinned v1.06.T1 process.

clauses.anchor: Notes, bullet 3: "Do not replace the mod wholesale or add third-party code/assets."
clauses.note: check:submission-shape (plugins/isaac-rebirth/src/rhenium_isaac_rebirth/evaluator.py:164-188) only requires exodus/main.lua and exodus/metadata.xml to exist and rejects symbolic links. Nothing compares the submission with the starter.

known_issues: Over-constraining: grid_worm_bounce (benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/suite/main.lua:929-932) requires the tear to be >= 35 units from the struck wall tile on the FIRST frame on which its velocity is seen reversed. Both baselines reverse on the same frame (age=2); the starter is then at 30.0 and the reference at 40.0, only because gold adds `Position = Position + Velocity` in the reversal frame. A repair that reverses once per impact and lets the tear fly clear on the following frames (30, 40, 50 ...) rebounds cleanly and never oscillates, yet is measured at 30 and rejected. Control alternative-strict-reading demonstrates this.

Fixture trap: tragic_mushroom_diminishing (benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/suite/main.lua:343-351) requires the third speed gain to be > 0.05 while the engine clamps MoveSpeed at 2.0. Isaac starts at 1.0 and the first use adds 0.6, so only 0.4 of headroom is left for uses two and three; any valid diminishing series whose second speed gain is >= 0.35 (decay ratio >= ~0.58) reports a third gain <= 0.05 and fails. The reference itself only shows 0.10 instead of its nominal 0.15.

Internal-name coupling: several cases read or write mod-internal GetData() fields that exist in the starter but are not public contracts: ReturnChance (benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/suite/main.lua:671,691; a repair that marks an excluded split tear with ReturnChance=0 instead of leaving it nil fails deja_vu_split_guard although nothing returns), parentEnemy (benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/suite/main.lua:774), IsExodusLobbed (benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/suite/main.lua:1024,1053) and the candle fields IsLit/LitTimer (benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/suite/main.lua:513-514,530-531). A repair that renames or restructures these fields is rejected or cannot be driven by the fixture.

ritual_candle_cadence (benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/suite/main.lua:548) requires exactly 4 damage callbacks in 8 frames. The 2-frame interval is only implied publicly ("roughly twice as often as the intended rounded interval"); nearest-integer rounding of 4/3 gives 1 and keeps 8 hits, so only a ceil-like reading passes.

Order dependence: the thirty main-suite cases share one run and one player (benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/suite/main.lua:264-1009). State leaks forward (Forbidden Fruit's +0.99 damage is part of every later damage figure; Mutant Clover is silently replaced by Anamnesis before its reset guard; a pcall failure in any step emits GCB_FATAL and leaves every later case unobserved).

Shared game-log markers (private NOTES.md, Verifier design): results are parsed from unauthenticated `[GCB_CASE]` lines written through Isaac.DebugString into the same log the submission can write to, so outcomes are only meaningful under the honest-code assumption.

Process coupling: the secret-room process runs with continued=true as player_type=18 (James), inheriting the James process's run from Steam's in-memory cache (benchmarks/isaac-core/private/harbor/isaac-exodus-release-regressions/tests/test.sh:85-108). apocryphon_stats and blue_moon are therefore measured on James, who already owns The Apocryphon.

validation/case-contracts.tsv labels eight cases `guard`; two of them (tragic_mushroom_diminishing, anamnesis_charge_persistence) fail in the unchanged starter and are mapped as target here. validation/predicate-matrix.tsv agrees: the EX-303 and EX-318 single-report candidates newly pass them.
